//: Starting-point config. This repo has patterns knip can't trace automatically: (1) src/backend/** is a SHARED library copied to functions/src/_shared by sync-shared.mjs and consumed there, so it is marked as entry; (2) the app renders tabs/overlays through dynamic routing in App.tsx, so screen roots are entry; (3) sweep/check/eval run via their own tsconfig outputs. Tune before treating 'unused files' as authoritative; 'unused exports' within traced files is the more reliable signal.
